segments.text: Weekly sync. Dev, the pipeline.
Bad news first. The events pipeline is going to slip. The source team changed the schema again on Thursday. Three renamed columns, no notice.
Again?
Again. I lost two days to it. I need to move the pipeline to Wednesday the 23rd.
The 23rd. Anika, does that kill the dashboard date?
It squeezes it. I can keep the 25th if the pipeline lands on the 23rd and nothing else breaks. If it slips again, I move too.
Okay. The dashboard stays the 25th for now.
And about the schema. I want a registry. Nothing lands in BigQuery unless it matches a registered schema.
Decision: we add a schema registry in front of the events load. Rationale, two schema breaks in a month.
Thank you.
Second thing. Platform told me the nightly backup window moves to one thirty to two thirty from next week. Our two a.m. job collides with it.
Then we move to three. Three a.m. IST. The dashboard is still fine by eight.
Decision: the nightly events job moves to three a.m. IST, from two. Rationale, the backup window.
Fine. Nobody's up at three either.
Me. The migration plan went to finance on Friday the 11th.
They want a monthly cost estimate with the BigQuery numbers. I'll have the cost estimate to them by Friday the 18th.
Should I include the dashboard query costs in that?
Yes. Send me what you have.
Lumen dashboard. I've repointed the sales models to dbt, waiting on the pipeline for real data. On track for the 25th if Dev is.
I will be. The 23rd is real this time.
Decisions since kickoff: schema registry, three a.m. Stale: nothing, the pipeline moved and has a date. Done.
Bye.
